usedFor: Microsoft To Do tracks tasks, and Google Docs logs it when “Completed Task” runs “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Completed Task” in Microsoft To Do, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Finished work is written into a doc tab, which makes a ready progress log for a weekly update.

watchOut: “Completed Task” in Microsoft To Do is polling, so entries land after a scheduled check, not on completion.
